text.tspan: Share in extreme poverty vs. life expectancy at birth, 2020
Life expectancy at birth is defined as the average number of years a newborn would live if age-specific mortality rates
in the current year were to stay the same throughout its life. Extreme poverty is defined as living below the International
Poverty Line of $2.15 per day, adjusted for inflation and for differences in the cost of living between countries.
Data source: World Bank PIP, Data compiled from multiple sources by World Bank
